channel.title: Illustrated Notes by Anirudh Srinivasan
channel.description: Animated, illustrated deep dives on machine learning systems, vision-language models, deep learning, and neural architectures.

item.title: The Parallelism Playbook: How Large Models Train Across Clusters
item.description: A first-principles guide to distributed training, from NCCL collectives and DDP to ZeRO/FSDP, tensor, pipeline, context, and expert parallelism.

item.title: Talk is not cheap: From PCIe and NVLink to InfiniBand
item.description: A guide to GPU communication through PCIe, NVLink, NVSwitch, RDMA, InfiniBand, network topology, collectives, and overlap.

item.title: Bound by Bytes: Compute-Bound and Memory-Bound Workloads
item.description: A practical guide to the Roofline model, arithmetic intensity, machine balance, and diagnosing compute-bound versus memory-bound workloads.

item.title: New Mask, Same Task: CPU and GPU Parallelism Explained
item.description: A first-principles guide to CPU and GPU parallelism, execution hierarchies, memory hierarchies, coalescing, tiling, and tensor cores.

item.title: The VLM Architecture Gallery
item.description: Seventy-one vision-language model architectures on one standardized plate, from gated cross-attention to encoders absorbed into the base model.

item.title: From Pixels to Visual Tokens
item.description: What changed in the visual half of VLMs: intake geometry, resolution, objectives, connectors, and the encoders models actually ship.

item.title: One Transformer, Two Modalities
item.description: A block-by-block comparison of language Transformers and Vision Transformers.

item.title: An Image Is a Sentence: How Vision Transformers See
item.description: An interactive field guide to ViT, DeiT, PVT, Swin, CvT, ConViT, CoAtNet, MViT, TimeSformer, and ViViT.

item.title: Across the CNNVerse
item.description: A visual field guide to convolution and the lineage from LeNet through ResNet, EfficientNet, and ConvNeXt.

item.title: Evolution of ML Architectures
item.description: Sixty-seven years of neural architectures, information flow, training cost, inference state, and gradient paths.

item.title: How Models Know Where They Are
item.description: Absolute, sinusoidal, relative, RoPE, NoPE, 2D and Fourier position features, and multimodal M-RoPE explained visually.

item.title: How Models Take a Step
item.description: A mechanical tour from SGD to Muon: optimizer updates, state costs, and distributed training bottlenecks.

item.title: The Geometry of Normalization
item.description: Normalization from BatchNorm to Peri-LN, including why the modality interface in a VLM is a normalization problem.

item.title: The Activation Atlas
item.description: From sigmoid and ReLU to GELU, SwiGLU, and squared ReLU, with animated derivations and model comparisons.
